ssmsi_dep.notes: Downloaded with curl 2026-10-18 (dataset last updated July 2026, files produced 2026-06-25). Rows filtered by Code_departement for the DROM code; indicators 'Homicides' (metadata PDF: 'Homicides (y compris coups et blessures volontaires suivis de mort)', unit of count = Victime) and 'Tentatives d'homicide' (unit Victime). 'nombre' = recorded victims by place of commission; 'taux_pour_mille' = per 1,000 inhabitants using insee_pop of the millésime shown; converted here to a rate per 100,000 by multiplying by 100 (noted in each row). The regional base gives identical figures for the same territory (each DROM is one région). The communal base does NOT carry the homicide indicators (metadata table: homicides and attempted homicides are available in regional and departmental bases only).

problems:
# Sub-national homicide figures — SSMSI (France), overseas département

- Source: SSMSI "Bases statistiques communale, départementale et régionale de la délinquance enregistrée par la police et la gendarmerie nationales" (data.gouv.fr, Licence Ouverte 2.0, files produced 2026-06-25, years 2016–2025). Downloaded by direct download on 2026-10-18.
- The territory is a single département (and a single région), so the departmental base gives ONE figure per year for the whole territory. These rows are written with level "country" (= the whole territory). Both "Homicides" (incl. coups et blessures volontaires suivis de mort) and "Tentatives d'homicide" are included, count and rate.
- Rate: the base publishes taux_pour_mille (per 1,000 inhabitants); rows give it ×100 as per 100,000, with the published value kept in the note. Population millésime differs by year (Mayotte uses the 2017 population for every year; 2024–2025 use the 2023 population) — shown in each note.
- No split below the territory: the communal base (donnee-data.gouv-2025-geographie2026-produit-le2026-06-25.csv.gz, 38 MB) was downloaded and filtered; it covers all communes of 971/972/973/974/976 but carries only 15 indicators and NOT homicides or attempted homicides (the metadata PDF's availability table marks homicide indicators as regional and departmental only). Communal figures are also suppressed ("ndiff") where a commune had ≤5 facts in 3 successive years.
- Not checked for lack of time / connection resets: SSMSI "Atlas départemental de la délinquance enregistrée" PDFs, préfecture "bilan de la délinquance" press releases (these may give per-arrondissement or per-commune homicide counts), INSEE/CépiDc deaths by assault by département.
- data.gouv.fr connections were frequently reset by the proxy; downloads needed several retries.
